scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.build:single: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build -w client && node scripts/promote-vercel-output.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
